about: What stands where: each fixture and part is a placement of an item (items/<item>/item.json says what the thing is; here is only which one, where, and what is particular to this placement), plus the stands of the tool rack and the gripper each one holds. Poses are in the table frame.

fixtures.name: assembly holder base plate with legs (matt_holder_81x55_legs_gray2_metal of Assem_holder_metal-0.1)
assembly holder: the wallet pocket (holder3_metal of Assem_holder_metal-0.1)
45 deg case stack, front cases (Assem_top_full__direct1_45_full)
fixtures.note: CAD as drawn: the mounted print has the floor channel filled to a flat 45 deg slope (see MISSING.md)

fixtures.name: 45 deg case stack, back cases (Assem_top_full__direct1_45_full)
fixtures.note: CAD as drawn: the mounted print has the floor channel filled to a flat 45 deg slope (see MISSING.md)

fixtures.name: green button plate (matt_holder_80x70_green)
fixtures.note: xy and yaw from the touch-measured body centre (the 72 x 82 mm tray, long side along table x); its four screw holes then fall on the breadboard grid within 0.5 mm. The buttons lie on the recessed floor, 3 mm above the board.

fixtures.name: PCB tray: base plate with two 10-slot holders (Assem_pcb)
fixtures.note: stands on 60 mm standoffs that are not in the CAD (see MISSING.md)

fixtures.name: screw feeder (simplified envelope), front facing table -y
fixtures.note: placed so the FRONT HOLE of the disc (2.2 mm, 20 mm in front of the disc centre) is on the measured pick station, base on the board. Front toward table -y, centre line on a breadboard hole column. The body then ends at y 0.612 — 12 mm past the 0.6 m board edge; the model is an approximate envelope.
